training.checkpoint_selection: minimum unchanged validation normalized pose loss

groups.precedence: first second -> startup; then angular speed >=15 -> turn; then speed <0.1 or absolute smoothed tangential acceleration >0.2 -> startup/transition; otherwise approximately steady cruise

sampling: Same original cache and normalization. Balanced arm draws 796 examples per group per epoch, cycling shuffled group members when needed; shuffle the combined epoch. Control uses original uniform randperm. Labels affect sampling only, never inference.

selection.rule: Prefer balanced only if unchanged validation flights show >=2% lower 1-second step-length RMSE, no mean Sim3 ATE regression, exact unchanged rotations, <=5% peak fuel increase. Otherwise retain teacher. Freeze before public evaluation; report both arms regardless.

scope: One fixed sampling contrast, same seed and training budget. Exact teacher C++ inference sources and build settings. No new data, architecture, loss, calibration, map or V8 fusion changes. Public set already inspected; no independent generalization claim or server submission.
